data.raw_text:
A girl in Manila pays for coffee with the yield she earned.
Posts the receipt on @cookiedotfun.
Gets $VEERA.
Buys groceries.
Posts again.
Someone in Lagos sees it, signs up, repeats.
No ads.
No KOLs.
Just real stories → real users → real volume.
@On_Veera becomes the first app where money spreads faster by people telling the truth about it than by banks printing it.
Cookie lights the match.
Veera is the fire.
The future of finance isn’t built.
It’s told.
And everyone who says it gets paid.
That’s the whole vision.
Short enough to fit on a cookie.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 07 December 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Jomalig, General Nakar, Infanta, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Real, Mauban, Sampaloc, Perez, Alabat, Quezon, Calauag, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan, Lopez, Buenavista, Catanauan, Mulanay, San Narciso, San Andres, San Francisco, General Luna, Macalelon, Gumaca, Pitogo, Atimonan, Plaridel, Unisan, Agdangan, Padre Burgos).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Laguna, Quezon(Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Pagbilao, Dolores, Candelaria, Sariaya, Tiaong, San Antonio), Rizal(Tanay, Pililla, Jala-Jala) and Batangas(San Juan, Padre Garcia, Rosario, Taysan, Lobo, Santo Tomas, Lipa, San Jose, Ibaan, Batangas City, Balete, Malvar, Tanauan, Mataasnakahoy, Cuenca, San Pascual, Alitagtag).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Bulacan, Bataan and Pampanga within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal(Rodriguez, Antipolo, Baras, San Mateo, Angono, Binangonan, Cainta, Cardona, Morong, Taytay, Teresa), Metro Manila(Marikina, San Juan, Mandaluyong, Quezon City, Pasig, Muntinlupa, Taguig, Makati, Pateros) and Batangas(Mabini, Bauan, Tingloy, San Luis, Santa Teresita, Taal, San Nicolas, Agoncillo, Lemery, Lian, Tuy, Balayan, Calaca, Calatagan) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
